open_points.subject: store.page_records / list_records paging over mutable record types
open_points.text: "Items come newest first, in reverse store order (K-17). The continuation token is the store position of the last item returned; the next page starts below it"
open_points.question: For records that can change status (`runs`, `bindings`, `standing grants`), is their "store position" the creation position only, or does an update create a new position for paging/order?
options: Position is fixed at record creation; updates do not change paging order
Each update gets a new store position and can reorder the record in later pages
open_points.default_guess: Position is fixed at creation, with updates in place.

open_points.subject: read_spooled_file identity validation (`map_index` / `list_index`)
open_points.text: "`read_spooled_file` ... names it by its identity ... `map_index` (omitted for a node that is not mapped) ... `list_index` (omitted for a `one` port) ... an identity naming no SpooledFile is `unknown_reference`"
open_points.question: If `map_index` or `list_index` is present/absent in the wrong form for the actual producer node/port, is that a malformed request (`invalid_request`/`refused`) or `unknown_reference`?
options: Treat wrong presence/absence as malformed input (`invalid_request` or `refused`)
Treat it as `unknown_reference` because no exact SpooledFile identity matches

open_points.subject: Continuation token validity when filtered membership changes between pages
open_points.text: "`store.page_records` ... refusing a token that names no position" and "a token is bound to its record type and filter"
open_points.question: If a record returned on page 1 changes and no longer matches the bound filter before page 2, does its token still name a valid continuation point for that filtered list?
options: Yes: token is an absolute store position; continue below it regardless of current filter match of that record
No: token is valid only if the anchor record still belongs to the filtered list
open_points.default_guess: Yes, continue from absolute store position.
